messages.subject: IRT scoring in MIRT
parts:
Hi Phil, 

I have run IRT analysis and obtained the coefficients and factor scores for the tryout data. The results of the IRT analysis is planned to be applied to new datasets. So my question is how to obtain the factor scores for the new datasets by using the coefficients that has been obtained from the tryout data? 
Is there any command in mirt to obtain such factor scores? 

Best, 
Agung

messages.author: 71bfb5f1e96782a8
messages.subject: Re: IRT scoring in MIRT
parts: you can use the fscores() function and feed in the new data with the response.pattern argument.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: IRT scoring in MIRT
parts:
Yes, use something like 

mymodel <- mirt(...)
saveRDS(mymodel, 'mymodel.rds')

and distribute this object to the individuals when they want to use your fitted object. If you worry about data sensitivity though then you could use the related mirtCAT::generate.mirt_object() to build the model from scratch, and supply the parameter estimates you previously computed in a more manual way. There's several ways to go about this (see also information from mod2values(mymodel) ), but that's two viable options.

Phil
